data.name: Bikini Heaven
data.detailed_description:
Swap tiles. Unlock art. Watch it move.

Bikini Heaven is a free anime artwork puzzle game for adults. Reconstruct a scrambled pin-up illustration by swapping any two tiles — no sliding, no empty spaces, just pure swap freedom. Solve the puzzle and the artwork comes to life as an animated reward video.

How It Works


Select any two tiles and swap them to reorder the scrambled image. Unlike traditional sliding puzzles, there's no empty space to work around — you have complete freedom to swap any two tiles at any time. It's more intuitive, more strategic, and more satisfying.

Complete a puzzle and the full high-resolution illustration is revealed — followed by an animated reward video of the character. Your prize for every solve.

Three Ways to Play


  • Standard — Race against the clock and chase high scores on the leaderboard.
  • Relaxed — No timers, no pressure. Solve at your own pace.
  • Challenge — Strict move and time limits for hardcore puzzlers.

Four Difficulty Levels


  • Easy — 3×3 grid. Perfect for beginners.
  • Medium — 5×5 grid. A satisfying challenge.
  • Hard — 8×8 grid. Serious puzzle territory.
  • Extreme — 16×16 grid. For the dedicated few.

Features


  • Animated Reward Videos — Every completed puzzle unlocks a unique animated video of the character.
  • High-Resolution Gallery — All unlocked artwork and videos saved to your in-game gallery to revisit anytime.
  • Custom Image Import — Bring your own images and turn any photo into an unlimited puzzle.
  • Weekly Challenge — Compete on the Steam leaderboard with a rotating 16×16 challenge puzzle.
  • Full Controller Support — Play with mouse, keyboard, touch, or controller.
  • Steam Achievements — Earn achievements for puzzle milestones and challenge completions.
  • 28 Languages Supported — Localized for players worldwide.
  • Steam Cloud Saves — Your progress syncs across devices.

Free to Play + Optional DLC


The base game is completely free and includes 6 puzzles with full artwork and reward videos.

Optional DLC packs ($0.99 each) expand the content with themed illustration sets:
  • Summer Paradise — Bright beach vibes and summer scenes.
  • Sporty Girls — Athletic energy and sporty aesthetics.
  • Sunset Beach — Golden-hour illustrations with a warm coastal feel.
  • Lifeguard Bay — Sun, surf and our first pack starring the guys.
  • Midnight Cove — Moonlit gothic beach romance with an emo vampire heartthrob.

Each DLC pack is self-contained — buy what you like, skip what you don't.

Mature Content Notice


This game contains suggestive poses and scantily clad anime characters. Intended for players 18+. Nudity and sexual content may be visible.

If you enjoy the game, leaving a review helps us keep creating content — thank you!
